examples.name: Named steps with a current position
examples.description: The default tracker: the bar fills to the current step, whose label is highlighted.

examples.name: Visited steps as links
examples.description: Give steps before the current one an href so people can jump back.

examples.name: Large
examples.description: The lg size thickens only the bar; labels stay heading-xs.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled tracker greys the fill and every label, switches the track border to the disabled token, and removes links.

antiExamples.name: Determinate percentage
antiExamples.reason: Use Progress Bar for a task/system completion percentage, not a step tracker.

antiExamples.name: Peer views
antiExamples.reason: Use Tabs to switch between peer views; Progress Tracker is for a linear sequence.

antiExamples.name: Unlabelled tracker
antiExamples.reason: Give the tracker an accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.
